_about: Which facts a beverage package carries in the Lexicon (Track C7b). Operator ruling 2026-10-31 (memory 446c35a2): a stored package price INCLUDES the gratuity, and the gratuity is knowledge that can go stale and must be marked as such. So price_per_day is the gratuity-inclusive figure; where a source gives a base price plus a stated percentage, base_price_per_day is filed as given and price_per_day is computed from it and the line's beverage_gratuity_rate statement (cruise.line pack), naming both in its lineage, so when either goes stale the price reads stale too (Project-Sophos sophos/src/lexicon/freshness.mjs). ttl_days 90 is the Lexicon plan's freshness for line prices (LEXICON-PLAN-3.1 section 6, cruise.line: prices 90d). Tekton itw-c7b-package-prices; assets/data/entities/README.md#drink-package-prices-track-c7b. Soli Deo Gloria.

identity.key: package:<line>.<slug>, where <line> is the line's id in brands.json and <slug> is the package's name in kebab case. Two stores' packages of one line are one package when their names normalise to the same text; anything else is its own package or is listed, never guessed (assets/data/lexicon/package-review.json).

source_kinds.line-official: the line's own site; evidence tier primary. Not yet read for packages
source_kinds.itw-data: a data file already in this repository; evidence tier secondary
